notes.title: Chapel Expansion & Much More! | Major Patch Notes - v1.3.6
notes.content:
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️

This update marks the completion of Phase 2 of our roadmap, bringing exciting new chapel upgrades, employees, languages, and a terrifying new blood moon event!

Here’s everything new in this update:


⛪ New Chapel Upgrades & Employees[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/dad7bcaebc18101fa720b7f4126274f539797e25.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/c40bc2de131750694a57d7bba119b710a743689b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/90fa751ee500b2f80218cfd8224117df58f1020e.png"][/carousel]
Priest, Pianist, and Custodian are now available to hire!

Sermon Altar: Prepare 3-sentence sermons in a mini-game. The quality of your words affects morale and boosts Chapel donations. If you hire a Priest, he can handle sermons automatically!

Piano: Hire a Pianist to play calming music for extra morale and increased donations

Confessional Booth: With a Priest, visitors will line up for confession, and the Priest will step in to listen

Chapel Cleaning & Maintenance: As more visitors attend, the Chapel will get dirty and candles will burn out. You can also perform all these tasks manually, but with a Custodian, the cleaning, candle-lighting and restocking of the Souvenir Shop can be automated.

Chapel Upgrade Tree: unlock Sermon Altar, Piano, Confessional, Faster Sermon Cooldown, and more by delivering successful sermons

New storage added inside the Souvenir Shop for faster access


🚻 Public Toilet Stalls

[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a26921f65f6f62299bc1dd5ed7dc31a60939bb30.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/27c3a4fbf458766f3d881808a4c152d84143d9e6.gif"][/carousel]
Visitors now have a place to take care of their needs

Toilets charge a small fee per use

After repeated use, toilets can clog, fix them with a plunger!

You can unlock up to 2 stalls


🪓New Weapon: Forest Axe
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/2a26c84e366d418ea6469c2c86726162e26c28d0.gif"]

    🗳️ This weapon was chosen based on community feedback and polls!

A new powerful Melee Weapon that deals much more damage than a shovel

Unlockable at Level 7


🌑 Blood Moon Event[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/46997bbe9dc3e03aff253cf6b69a43409837418a.png"]
On certain nights after leveling up, a Blood Moon may occur

The sky and moon turn red, and zombies become much stronger and more aggressive

Blood Moon can be toggled on/off in the settings


🔼 Increased Level Cap!
You can now reach level 10 and unlock new items, station upgrades, and more customization as you grow your graveyard empire!


🌐 New Languages
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a8837df1b64c221e9edf2af3da5f8e89f370eeb5.png"]

    🗳️ All four languages were selected based on community feedback and polls!

Portuguese (Brazil)

Dutch

Swedish

Ukrainian


🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements
Employees now keep their positions on Quick Save and after loading, they will appear exactly where they were last saved instead of respawning from the door

Added attack sound effects for both Axe and Shovel

Performance optimizations and minor fixes





📌 With Phase 2 now complete, we’re already working hard on what’s next!

Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!

💬 Feel free to join our Discord to report bugs, share ideas, or just say hi!

notes.title: What's the weather like today? | Patch Notes - v1.3.3
notes.content:
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️

This update brings new weather effects to enhance the atmosphere, plus a brand new Zombie Waves modifier for those who want a completely different gameplay experience!

Here’s everything new in this update:


🌦️ New Weather Types[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a72011f79500f033b04c521f8792f52e9769d5ea.gif"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a385c69c78202f6bbb1744573c47c7c451ab74d0.gif"][/carousel]
Clear – Classic & sunny skies with a bright atmosphere

Foggy – Low visibility for an eerie graveyard feel

Heavy Rain – Stormy downpours to set the scene


⛔ Say Goodbye to Zombies
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/3a88025a167e5c577b1667ac348d2ccd5b0bf786.png"]

Added a Zombie Waves toggle in Game Modifiers that lets you completely disable night zombie waves.

This means you can now play from start to finish without encountering zombies at all!

⚠ Important Note: This is an experimental setting and goes against the game’s intended balance. With no zombie waves, you won’t lose graves and progression will be much easier. Defense costs will also be completely removed since you don't need them.


🛍️ Souvenir Shop Visual Changes[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/93fe231e0de2b36da4dbbaf8665d8d42d34d945c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/b06ee5b97046f0f737b8221d0237674e21869e70.png"][/carousel]
Souvenir Shop visual redesign now has a more store-like appearance with new glass walls, sliding door, tile, lamps!


🃏 Blackjack Changes
Added spending and winnings limits to Blackjack

Removed the reward for running out of money in Blackjack

Fixed several logic issues in Blackjack

Fixed an exploit where quitting mid-game avoided losing money


🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements
Employees are now listed under their work area instead of just by job type

Increased hiring limit of Gravekeepers and Technicians from 2 to 4 in total

Removed zombie entrances unlocked with Graveyard Expansion 2 to allow for a more balanced defense layout

Fixed an issue where starting a new game didn’t trigger the tutorial in rare occasions

Updated Delivery Guy appearance (new Outfit and Hat)

Fixed an issue where leaving the Custom Urn Station mid-filling could cause errors

Fixed a issue where Delivery Only urns didn’t complete the "Urn Ready" task after successful delivery


[hr][/hr]

🌐 New Languages
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a8837df1b64c221e9edf2af3da5f8e89f370eeb5.png"]

The new languages planned for Phase 1 have now been moved to the Phase 2 major update due to localization work in the upcoming update. This is where we need your help!

We’ve prepared a list of potential languages based on player demand and community size, but we can’t add them all at once. 

Head over to our Discord server and check the #dev-updates where you can vote for which 3 languages should be added first. Join the poll and help us decide which languages will come to the game next!



Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!

💬 Feel free to join our Discord to report bugs, share ideas, or just say hi!

notes.title: High Stakes & Hot Ashes | Major Patch Notes - v1.3.1
notes.content:
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️
This update is part of our ongoing work to complete Phase 1 of the roadmap and bringing key new features, cremation upgrades, and the first community-voted weapon!

Here’s what’s new:


 ⚱️ Custom Urn Station
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/97b6b934c5fd54051ea7a16dd0429ed9d136addc.gif"]

5 new Urn variations added

Bodies may now request Specific Urn Types as special requests

Use the Custom Urn Station to transfer ashes into the correct urn to fulfill these requests

Higher-quality urns = higher payouts!


🚚Delivery Station & Upgrades[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/bc9d7645fcfde2da37da453a789fb8f9e22035d0.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/50266b4b37f11c228ac3a1e800d6ef83f9c5b934.png"][/carousel]
Some urns are now marked as Delivery Only

Use the Delivery Station to pack ashes and place them in delivery boxes

A courier will arrive at scheduled times to pick up the packages

Delivery orders provide even greater money!

A new upgrade panel for the Crematorium has been added (Old one was re-labeled as Furnaces)

Unlock and improve the new Custom Urn and Delivery systems through this panel


🔼 Increased Level Cap!
You can now reach level 9 and unlock new items, station upgrades, and more customization as you grow your graveyard empire!


🃏 Blackjack Minigame
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/6ed0f6b4d90b180a0725839e964c5dd27e6bcfb6.gif"]

Take a break and play Blackjack using in-game money

Play it safe or go all in, the graveyard economy just got riskier!


🔫 M60 LMG
Over the past few weeks, we’ve hosted a series of community polls on Discord to decide which weapons should be added to the game next. Hundreds of players voted, and the first winner is finally here!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/71710140906f50e7baf85142f3dfc140cdfeb6d3.gif"]

A powerful light machine gun with a high fire rate and large magazine and perfect for mowing down hordes of zombies during late-night waves.


But that’s just the beginning!

This is the first of five new weapons selected by our community. Here’s the full lineup coming in future updates:

P90 SMG – Compact, fast, and ideal for close quarters

Desert Eagle – Heavy pistol with serious stopping power

Axe – Our first melee weapon for up-close action

Type 20 Rifle – Reliable, balanced long-range option

🛠 Bug Fixes & Improvements
Urns now display cause of death and additional info

DLSS and FSR can no longer be enabled at the same time (fixed related bugs)

Fixed zombie difficulty not updating properly when switching Relaxed Mode

Fixed bug where dragging urns too quickly could cause them to become invisible

Fixed an issue where the cremation progress bar could get stuck at 99%

Fixed crematorium effects not appearing after certain save/load scenarios

Fixed occasional sound overlap when multiple actions triggered at once

Fixed UI scale issue when opening Management App on ultra-wide monitors



📌 We’re getting closer to completing Phase 1, but there’s still more to come!

Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!

💬 Feel free to join our Discord to report bugs, share ideas, or just say hi!

notes.title: Quick Save & Quick Management | Patch Notes - v1.3.0
notes.content:
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️

Today’s update brings highly-requested features, quality-of-life improvements, and important bug fixes. We heard your feedback loud and clear, Quick Save was requested frequently, so we moved it up in our plans to get it to you sooner!

Here’s everything new in this update:


💾 Custom Save System[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/e41a33768061b4cf61d5ee0ae8f92c0ce7838699.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/15f211b783f371f0c0f22a3d1ea85791826c9e67.png"][/carousel]
You can now Quick Save from the pause menu during daytime!

Added save date/time indicator so you can see when you last saved.


📈 New Management App
A big new tool to track your progress:
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/cbed922cdee1c84e12adbc94b30a8119fbe40eee.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a8dc7bdaabbd8541a439579f456b1acc803608b1.png"][/carousel]
Track visitor trends to see what’s popular and what's not.

View visitor counts for the last 10 days and visitor activities from the last 5 days.

Check detailed statistics on your income.

See a complete list of all buried bodies, including how much money you've earned from each grave.

Note: The Management App begins tracking data after this update! Previous progress won’t appear.


🌙 Relaxed Mode Preset & Custom Modifiers
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/23150d3810d3fb24977eff52b3f531557a4fdada.png"]

Relaxed Mode is now a preset of custom modifiers! You can now change & tune the game to your liking:

New Zombie Waves difficulty settings: Relaxed, Easy, Normal, Hard

Toggle Longer Days (On/Off).

Toggle Energy System (On/Off). Disabling this means actions won’t require energy!

Toggle Preparation Phase (On/Off). Previously always active in Relaxed Mode.

Note: You don't need to start a new game to change the options, you can change them in the settings menu. Just make sure to check if the settings are correct after the update!

📊 Reputation Score System
Your actions now directly impact your graveyard’s popularity:

Doing things right grants points, mistakes lower your score.

Your reputation determines visitor likelihood and affects your overall success.


⚙️ Performance & Compatibility
Added AMD FSR support for improved performance and visuals.

Optimized GPU usage to reduce overall load.

Improved optimization to minimize FPS spikes.

Better scaling for Quality Presets (Low, Medium, High now clearer and more consistent).


🔧 Bug Fixes & Improvements
Added Camera Smoothing option in Settings for smoother camera motion (ideal for controllers).

Fixed controller not working on some panels (like Game Over) — now fully functional.

Added Steam Deck button prompts for Steam Deck players.

Re-mapped default controller buttons: Pause button now opens Pause Menu, Back button opens Inventory.

Improved damage value for R500 Revolver and DMR-14 Rifle.

Fixed Fertilizer Machine bug where compost boxes couldn’t be picked up after saving/loading.

Fixed early payment calculation error in the loan system.

Fixed an issue where money and item notifications could get stuck on screen.

Fixed localization issues in French and German, along with general translation fixes.

Fixed a bug that allowed graves to be destroyed while a visitor was actively visiting them.

Fixed balance issues related to overall game difficulty.

Fixed an issue that prevented grave and gravestone placement after loading a saved game.

Fixed Technician Employee going to trash without a trash bag.

Crematorium ovens now show a burning indicator if you’re holding a corpse.

Various Input System updates for better controller detection.

Fixed bug where a corpse could disappear when trying to take it back from the furnace.

Fixed Gardener Employee leaving the farm area to grab items from storage unnecessarily.





Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!

💬 Feel free to join our Discord to report bugs, share ideas, or just say hi!

notes.title: Decorations & Stand Upgrades | Patch Notes - v1.2.9
notes.content:
Hi Gravediggers! 🧟‍♂️

Today’s patch brings a wide range of improvements including station upgrades, new decorations, and quality-of-life fixes to enhance your graveyard management experience. 

Also we created a new poll to chose upcoming weapons, scroll to bottom to read more!

Here’s what’s new in this update:


🪴 New Decorations & Visual Improvements[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/4c6912749b8d31285fea79c05aabaf2add644314.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/22b70dc3008944dd8340ce5702ba86ab63556491.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/786cdc6a5acaba6e3406e524a5d1793cf2a40324.png"][/carousel]
Modular stone tiles with corner and edge pieces for clean paths

2 updated and 2 brand-new flower pots

Empty flower pot that can be filled with any decorative bush

4 new short decorative fences

2 new garden lights

Large floodlight for wide-area illumination

Visual improvements made to Graveyard's walls, gates, and pillars


🌸 Flower Stand Upgrades & Special Requirements System[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/cec5c9a2e7e5a224d94083b02813d99ea62a494c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/75a0455e96863b3fdb28d22cdf654ac4dd4bcb86.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/01bdaf18764e5fd5f9ceaf348bca7a11459e33de.png"][/carousel]
Added new Special Requirement System for upgrades, some of them now require special requirements (such as Sell X amount bouquets for Flower Stand, Cremate X amount bodies for Crematorium)

Slider UI added to track special conditions progress and overall unlocks

Added Speaker Upgrade to increase visitor patience while queuing for Flower Stand

Crate Expansion Upgrade doubles flower storage capacity for Flower Stand

Fragrance Dispenser Upgrade increases flower sale chance for Flower Stand

Assigned flower types now shown as “Assigned Flower” in the description box

3D “Low Stock!” warning appears when overall flower stock is low


🎯 Gameplay & Mechanics Improvements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/5e6d0016d900534ef108f2ef8344dd37c0b35d30.gif"]

Graves now spawn a zombie when completely destroyed

Turrets now avoid shooting barricades if they’re in the line of sight, reducing wasted ammo

Turrets now aim at zombie bodies instead of their center, improving accuracy when zombies crouch to eat graves or get too close

Shovel can now be bought back from the Market if accidentally sold

Guns with magazines now preserve the chamber round when reloading

Graveyard area slightly expanded for better symmetry and pathing


📦 Inventory & Market Enhancements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/b96aff52b74decd945d8485d83e90e4a1b4aa83b.png"]

Added sort options to Inventory and Storage (Default or by Category)

Added filter tabs in Inventory and Storage for categories like Souvenirs and Ammunition

Market now shows how many of each selected item you own in both Inventory and Storage

Warning UI has been added to items that cannot be sold in the market.

Warning UI has been added to items that you don't have enough of to sell.


🧼 Bug Fixes & QoL
Fixed issue where Gravekeeper Employee cleaning would drain Player’s stamina

HireWire UI now shows job descriptions for each Employee

Florist Employee notifications now include the missing flower’s name if unavailable

Fixed issue where damaged graves didn’t display indicators

Fixed bug causing corpses to get stuck when quickly picked up from the Wheelbarrow

Fixed early payment calculation error in the loan system

Fixed issue preventing visitors from picking up the first placed urn

Fixed unfair pricing behavior in the sell system

Average daily income now displayed for each buried grave

Localization improvements across several languages


[hr][/hr]

🗳️ Vote for the Next Weapons!
We’re adding new weapons as part of upcoming roadmap updates and we want you to help decide which ones should we add and which ones should be first!

Head over to our Discord server and check the #dev-updates channel to vote in the first weapon poll. Once we have a winner, we’ll launch another poll… and keep going until we have a full lineup!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/29d12703eed4f4e3cea58b65d43a7e96c3b4b1b6.png"]

Thanks again for your continued support, bug reports, and feedback. We’re hard at work shaping the future of the graveyard with your help!

💬 Feel free to join our Discord to report bugs, share ideas, or just say hi!

notes.title: Better Chapel & Smarter AI | Patch Notes - v1.2.5
notes.content:
Hi Gravediggers, 🧟‍♂️

We’re back with another patch filled with improvements, new features, and a few long-awaited fixes!

We’re still working on our roadmap to give you a clearer picture of what’s coming next. It’s shaping up nicely and we’ll be sharing it soon!



Here’s what’s included in this update:

The Chapel interior has been updated to feel more atmospheric, it’s no longer just a room with benches. Something new might be waiting here soon…
[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/f1b0cb9b94eb13f25d39e9e9e6e50834dabcef11.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/2c8811909266b9d61024e11157861adb5d6b546e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/120cb81d9329a4d2b3facf3b5b7355e7a81df0db.png"][/carousel]
Completely overhauled pathfinding system for both Employees and Visitors. Movements are now smoother, more natural, and less prone to getting stuck (we hope!)

Employees and Visitors can now vault over fences just like the player

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/edefd1435005d791e8bb594caac0907affd752fe.gif"]

Florist Employee will now restock stands when no visitors are waiting

Added the ability to pause Employees without firing them, useful if you want them to just stand by

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/3244b0ff9c5117a39d490d6e0e4ddceaf00b84a7.gif"]

You can now sell unwanted items in the Dark Market at half price by switching to Selling Mode

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/2c17084c0d8d05669c2e4e2ef6d0b7020ebdd446.png"]

Added Buy/Sell whole stack toggle to the Dark Market UI for faster transactions

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/1c7ed38ae72dfa086c836b9c0c50372988aef372.png"]

Rotten corpses no longer disappear instantly, they now turn into rotten bags and can be removed manually if you threw them into trash container

Added auto-scroll navigation to Inventory and Storage UI when using a controller

Fixed an issue where scrolling down in Inventory and Storage would not work as intended

Fixed a issue where some buildable objects could be duplicated

Fixed an issue causing Hulk and Armored zombies’ health to multiply incorrectly

Fixed a issue that blocked the Souvenir Shop Tutorial progress

Added an “I’m Stuck” button to Pause Menu for emergencies. If you get stuck, just press it!

Fixed a bug where gravestones and defense structures lost their cleanliness/durability after loading a save

Fixed a rare Storage lockup bug when picking up an item at the same time as the Gardener Employee

Balance changes for turrets



As always, thank you for the feedback, bug reports, and love you’ve been sending. We’re working hard to keep the graveyard running smoothly and more updates are already on the way.

💬 Feel free to join our Discord to share feedback, ideas, or just say hi

notes.title: Big Zombie Alert 🚨 | Patch Notes - v1.2.2
notes.content:
Hi Gravediggers, 🧟‍♂️

Today’s update brings a solid batch of improvements, fixes, and a few new functions to make your graveyard duties smoother!

We’re also working on a roadmap to give you a clearer view of what’s coming next and we’ll be sharing it soon!

Here’s everything included in this patch:

Added new zombie type: Hulk – a stronger and more aggressive zombie that uses a Charge attack when it spots you from a distance. If it hits you, it’s going to hurt.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/f4453c58ac7a6fcd4cb82f764c0ccb2652225d24.gif"]

Added vaulting you can now jump over fences using the Jump key

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/f08a758591de85ebebf05d329e3d827fa30ae99b.gif"]

You can now dig up filled graves using the shovel

You can now completely destroy graves with the hammer

You can now destroy Planter Boxes using the hammer

Added filter category options to the Storage UI (like the Inventory UI)

Fixed an issue where the Storage UI wouldn’t open properly

Technician employee's task priority has been updated, they now clean trash first, then repair defenses

Removed the Decay system from defense objects, it was causing confusion and unnecessary breakdowns

Fixed bug where corpses placed on the ground could fall through the terrain after loading a save

The dead tree at the edge of the map can now be removed

Removed grid smoothing for grave placement, you can now place graves more precisely and symmetrically

Fixed collider issue with the trash container interaction

Fixed an issue where employees could get stuck while cremating

Fixed a bug where carrying a corpse while an employee uses the furnace would break the held corpse

Fixed bug where corpses weren’t removed from the pickup vehicle after auto-pickup

Added new default zombie models

Updated zombie wave configurations, nights now feature more varied wave types and enemy counts

Fixed an issue where the Brush animation would play when collecting water while holding the Brush

Prevented employees from interrupting the player while working on graves

Prevented employees from interrupting the player while working on Planter Boxes

Minor game balance adjustments

General performance improvements



As always, thank you all for playing, reviewing, bug reporting, and helping us push this little graveyard forward.

💬Feel free to Join our Discord to share feedback, ideas, or just say hi!

notes.title: Achievements are here! | Patch Notes - v1.2.0
notes.content:
Hi Gravediggers, 🧟‍♂️

We’re back with another update and this one brings something many of you have been asking for! Achievements!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/b59492716ceef542ed2ab5d00bc288f52a34bf2a.png"]

Along with that, we’ve rolled out several important bug fixes and performance improvements to make your graveyard duties smoother than ever.

Here’s what’s new:

Added a full Achievement System with 40 unlockable achievements tied to in-game actions

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/bc2169fb58d63ff80b010195ac1d3371b6428e88.png"]

Fixed a rare issue where employees could get stuck while trying to access the cremation furnace

More updates are on the way and thank you all for the continued feedback and support! 💬

💬 Join our Discord to report bugs, share feedback, or just say hi!

notes.title: Renovation & New Characters | Development Update #1
notes.content:
Hi dear Gravediggers!
I’m charlermaster from the development team of Zombie Graveyard Simulator.

First of all – a massive thank you to over 20,000 people who have played the game so far!
 
As we inch closer to release, we’ve been fixing bugs, yes! but also adding a ton of new features and improvements which you can try some of them in the updated Prologue and Demo versions right now!

Today’s update highlights two of the most requested changes from the community, and we’re super excited to share them with you!

🔨 Renovation System – Build Your Graveyard, Your Way
In the earlier versions of the game, your graveyard was basically handed to you on a silver platter. Clean, tidy, and ready to go. While convenient, it didn’t quite feel like you were turning a forgotten land into something meaningful.

That’s why we’ve introduced the Renovation System!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/cada0620bf79e2bc7c01b4fcc0b3c603ba949a48.png
Now, each major area starts off abandoned and broken down. You’ll need to clean, repair, and restore it yourself before you can use it. For example, the Chapel used to be instantly available but now, you’ll find it in ruins at first. Only after fixing it up will you unlock access and begin using its features. 

Once renovated, these stations actually matter!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/c30a6f02ca0544f42576dd9f03cfb54fe032a74d.png
Take the Chapel’s donation box for example. Visitors now donate based on your graveyard’s decoration and cleanliness levels. The better you maintain your graveyard, the more generous your visitors will be. It’s no longer just free money but it’s earned through your work.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/b6cf64eed06d71c469d671e84ada5c2eacb3aeaf.png
It isn’t just limited to the Chapel but other areas like the Crematorium follow the same principle. You’ll also notice new visitor behaviors and actions unique to these spaces.

🧍‍♀️ New Character Models – No More Clones!

Let’s be honest, we all noticed it. The old character models looked like they were from the same extended family… or military squad 😄. Same face, same clothes, and no variation.

Well, they’ve officially been evicted!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/08cce08649af42529093ed4d6622ae79793c5c63.png
We’ve introduced a whole new set of character models, with both male and female designs, a variety of faces, hairstyles, clothing, and colors. The graveyard now feels more alive and diverse, just like it should.

This change will also affect how employees look, though we’ll share more about them in a future update. For now, here’s a sneak peek of our new gardener and gravekeeper hard at work!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45418239/a06569287cbba6aef9f78a8bc9b5ecf77bb87580.png
There’s a lot more coming soon, but we’ll leave the rest for future updates.
Until then, we hope you enjoy these changes and the new faces around your graveyard!

Like we mentioned earlier, we've also updated both the Prologue and Demo versions of the game, so you can try out many of these new features yourself and give your feedback!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3623500/Zombie_Graveyard_Simulator__Prologue/

If you’re enjoying the game and want to support us, don’t forget to:

 Follow and Wishlist the game!
 Join our Discord to share feedback, ideas, or just say hi!
We’re always around and would love to hear from you.
